note: Triennial election, polled Friday 2 June 1939. There was no contest: nominations were received in sixteen of the twenty-two divisions and retiring members were returned without nomination in the other six. Co. Londonderry polled Friday 2 June 1939: 'Polling in the Enagh Lough Division ... took place yesterday' (Londonderry Sentinel, 3 June 1939, p. 8). Re-filed from 1939-05-31, a provisional date (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
